pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement BroadcastLoudnessStandard, ClearanceCategory, ClearanceStatus, QcVerdictStatus, BroadcastTraffickingSlateSpec, LoudnessComplianceSpec, PseFlashCheckSpec, ClearanceRecordSpec, SceneQcProfileSpec, and MasterBroadcastQcSpec schemas; omni_director.tools.broadcast_qc (PSE flash evaluator, loudness validator, rights clearance matrix, QC certificate Markdown/CSV/JSON exporters, [BROADCAST_QC: ...] prompt tokens); 6-domain calibration via get_domain_broadcast_qc_spec(); and an interactive Broadcast QC & Trafficking HUD [Q] in the dark-room animatic. Acceptance criteria: 0 PSE (>3Hz) failures, ATSC A/85 or EBU R128 PASS across all 6 archetypes, and HUD #btn-qc-animatic / #animatic-qc-hud.
